name: Chapter 2
description: Chapter 2 released as a major progression milestone.

name: Lycaros & Identify
description: Lycaros launched as a Weekly World Boss alongside the Identify equipment system.
highlights: Lycaros added as a Weekly World Boss
Identify system introduced for Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, and Upper, Middle, and Lower Headgear
Magnifying Glass introduced for identifying supported equipment
source: Official Discord big-updates patch announcement v1.1.6, 2026-08-09

name: Guilds & Arcane Defense
description: The Guild System and Arcane Defense launched as connected group-progression systems.
highlights: Guild System opened with Guild creation through Rendall
Arcane Defense launched as a Friday Guild activity started by the Guild Leader
Guild activities introduced Guild EXP and Guild Coin rewards
source: Official Discord big-update and Guild reward-system announcements by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20

name: Battle Pass Season 2
description: Announced to begin September 1, 2026; not yet presented as active as of this record's August 31 publication date.
highlights: Battle Pass Season 2 announced to begin September 1, 2026
Announced content includes Sunflower Crop, Fizz Drink, Mimic Chest Storage, Tier 5 Bag, +20 Soil, and the Enchanted title
source: Official Discord patch announcement v1.2.15 by Swaroff [PRTL], normalized to 2026-08-31 from the supplied same-day Discord timestamp
